reviews.explanation: The mention 王導 appears in annotation 002 as part of the phrase '桓温依諸葛亮王導故事', where Wang Dao is cited as a historical precedent alongside Zhuge Liang. The candidate evidence from data/people.json confirms 王導 as a canonical person name. The annotation explicitly names 王導 in the context of the imperial edict for Huan Wen, and the reference semantics correctly identify this as a distinct historical figure from Huan Wen, Zhuge Liang, and Emperor Jianwen. The evidence directly supports the identity resolution.

The mention 安 appears in annotation 001 as '(安/晉)', an abbreviated reference. The main text explicitly names 謝安 as one of the two officials Huan Wen intended to kill ('欲誅謝安王坦之'). The annotation 002 also mentions 謝安王坦之. The abbreviated form 安 in the annotation clearly refers to 謝安, as the annotation is glossing the main text passage about Xie An. The coreference chain and the main text evidence directly support this identity.

The mention 桓温 is the full name of Huan Wen, the central figure in this annotation passage. The main text and annotations consistently refer to 桓公, 桓温, and 温 as the same person. The candidate evidence from aliases.json confirms 桓温 as an orthographic variant. The annotation 002 explicitly names 桓温 in the edict context. The hard veto against c1 (explicit identity contradiction) is appropriate. The evidence directly supports this identity resolution.

The mention 温 is the abbreviated personal name of 桓温. The reference semantics note that it appears immediately after the full name 桓温 in the same annotation passage (annotation 002: '桓温依諸葛亮王導故事温'), where 温 clearly refers back to 桓温. The candidate evidence from the annotation source confirms this. The coreference with sfh1-mention-56ed6d4753c4a2d9601d2051 (桓温) is well-supported by the immediate textual context. The hard veto against c1 is appropriate.

The mention 温 appears in Liu annotation 006 within the context of 桓温's confrontation with 謝安. The annotation text explicitly references 温 multiple times in the context of 桓温's actions ('温笑曰', '温左右衛士'), and the main text establishes 桓公 as 桓温. The surface form 温 is the standard abbreviated personal name for 桓温. The supporting evidence directly places 温 in the narrative about 桓温's plot against 謝安 and 王坦之, matching the main text's 桓公. No contradicting evidence exists.

The surface form 謝安 is the full canonical name of Xie An. The main text explicitly names 謝安 as one of the two targets of 桓温's plot ('因此欲誅謝安王坦之'). The candidate evidence from people.json provides the canonical name match. The mention 謝 in Liu annotation 003 ('自此欲殺王謝') refers to 謝安, paired with 王 (王坦之). The main text explicitly states 桓温 sought to kill 謝安 and 王坦之 ('因此欲誅謝安王坦之'), and the annotation's 王謝 pairing directly corresponds to these two individuals. The surname 謝 as an abbreviated reference for 謝安 is contextually unambiguous given the main text's explicit naming. The distinct_from reference to 王坦之 (sfh1-mention-e1b4c99d78ad11c0ed75553f) is consistent with the pairing structure.

The mention 安 in Liu annotation 004 ('安能作洛下書生詠') refers to 謝安. The annotation quotes 宋明帝文章志 describing 安's ability to recite in the Luoxia scholar style, which directly corresponds to the main text's description of 謝安 performing 洛生詠 ('方作洛生詠諷浩浩洪流'). The coreference chain linking this mention to other 謝安 mentions (including sfh1-mention-81ce38b5fe2b727a8577a9e7 for the full name) is consistent. The abbreviated personal name 安 is the standard reference for 謝安 in this context. No contradicting evidence exists.
